questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third term in the same way the second term is related to the first term.

pRSq : tVWu :: iKLj : ?
questions.solution:
According to the positions of letter in English alphabet series:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f8a5c570f6f263d86d5c83b44ee4b334d2e65715d72500adbb6f48f63340f140.png]

The first and last letter is small while the middle two words are capital.

pRSq → p +2 = R ; S - 2 = q

tVWu → t +2 = V ; W-2 =u

Similarly,

**mOPn ****→**** m +2 = O ; P - 2 = n**

Hence, ‘mOPn’ is the correct answer.
